summary.text: John T. McDonald III is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly who has represented District 108 since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; he is a pharmacist by training and former mayor of Cohoes.

paragraphs.text: McDonald earned a B.S. in pharmaceutical sciences from the Albany College of Pharmacy in 1985.
He served as mayor of the City of Cohoes from 2000 to 2012.
McDonald assumed office in the Assembly on January 1, 2013, succeeding Steven McLaughlin.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as Alcoholism and Drug Abuse, Governmental Operations (which he chairs), Higher Education, Health, and Ways and Means.
